audit.whatIsWrong: Content chart reads Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas against the packet's Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill; and diffRating is 6/10 with report[14] calling it 'Even matchup' while diff is already set to FAV on a 56.49% win rate.
audit.why: The packet chart is what the prose says: whys[2] 'farm safely and don't over-commit a Body Slam he can wall off' is a Skill stage marked Gragas; whys[3] 'you win the extended trades' and whys[4] 'a real all-in' are Gragas stages marked Skill; whys[6] 'refuse the solo duel late' is not a Gragas stage. On difficulty, the mirror audit set Trundle's side to HARD at 7/10 — the inverse of that on this side is 3/10, not 6/10, and the two pages must not both call the lane hard for their own champion.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill on both layers; diffRating 3/10, difficulty and final-rating lines matched to it.

audit.why: Spikes are right and already carry the mirror's corrections: Gragas at 2 (Drunken Rage auto that Chomp's AD sap cannot touch), 6 (Body Slam-W-Q into Explosive Cask out of the Pillar zone), first item as the peak before Trundle buys MR, and Trundle late on Subjugate. Subjugate's 120/100/80 and Pillar's 21s at rank 1 anchor those timings and are now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate is summarised as 'Steals your stats' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, with no cooldown attached; and dontsFull[1] pairs the heading 'Get pillar-kited' with generic filler about burning a tool 'for tiny value'.
audit.why: Subjugate steals a percentage of the target's Health, Armor AND Magic Resistance, and DOUBLES the amount stolen over the next 4 seconds — it is not a flat stat tax, it is a swing that grows if you stay in the fight, which is precisely why burst-and-disengage is the answer. It runs 120/100/80, the longest cooldown either champion has, so it is trackable. Pillar of Ice at 21/19.5/18/16.5/15 is the other decisive number: it is impassable terrain that walls off Body Slam (the mirror reversed this claim from its side), and at 21s it is down more often than Gragas's 14s E — but a Pillar spent is a free dash window. Chomp is 3.5s and saps ATTACK DAMAGE only, so it never blunts Gragas's magic trade — the page already has this right.
audit.corrected: Subjugate: 120s at rank 1, steals health/armour/MR and doubles the theft over 4 seconds. Pillar of Ice: 21s at rank 1, impassable terrain that walls Body Slam. Chomp: 3.5s, saps AD only.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan'.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1. Against Trundle it matters twice over: a Pillar-blocked dash costs 14 seconds against a 3.5s Chomp.
